engineMeta.description: Conditional rule matrix for generating personalized 21-day, 14-day, and 7-day success identity transition paths.

actionSteps: Drink 500ml of room-temperature mineral water rapidly within 15 minutes of waking.
under_40.justification: Flushes nighttime cellular waste and rapidly fires up metabolism to clear early morning cognitive resistance.

actionSteps: Drink 500ml of warm water immediately upon waking to gently stimulate the vagus nerve and kickstart digestive motility.
over_40.justification: Soathes age-related autonomic nervous system sensitivity and reduces early morning cardiovascular strain.

actionSteps: Sit near a window or step onto a balcony for 10 minutes of effortless daylight contact. Keep eyes open without looking at screens.
Survivor.justification: Suppresses lingering melatonin production with zero physical effort, providing baseline neurological safety.

actionSteps: Step completely outside and walk slowly for 10 minutes facing the morning horizon.
Soldier.justification: Begins transitioning the body from forced willpower to natural, light-driven biological pacing.

actionSteps: View direct morning sunlight for 15 minutes while executing light dynamic joint mobility or structural stretching.
Warrior.justification: Maximizes the morning cortisol spike to anchor peak daily focus thresholds for high-performance creative execution.

actionSteps: Open the morning psychological card module inside the app.
Read the daily behavioral strategy and actively map it to your morning schedules or client negotiations.
all.justification: Capitalizes on peak morning neuroplasticity to hardwire strategic interpersonal mastery schemas before external interaction loops begin.

actionSteps: Consume a freshly prepared, warm vegetarian meal emphasizing clean bio-available proteins like lentils, sprouted grains, or paneer paired with healthy fats.
Vegetarian.justification: Protects fragile digestive boundaries, preventing blood-sugar crashes and age/diet-related bloating or executive brain fog.

actionSteps: Consume a high-protein whole-food clean meal (such as eggs, poultry, or fish) paired strictly with leafy greens and zero refined simple carbohydrates.
Non-Vegetarian.justification: Stabilizes insulin response profiles to completely eliminate the classic post-lunch focus slump during intense software or business sprints.

actionSteps: Consume a dense plant-based anti-inflammatory meal mixing amino acids (tempeh, hemp seeds, quinoa) with raw nuts and steamed greens.
Vegan.justification: Maintains a constant steady stream of steady glucose to optimize mitochondrial cellular energy production without digestive overload.

actionSteps: Completely eliminate all caffeine and stimulant beverages past 12:00 PM noon.
Survivor.justification: Protects an already exhausted central nervous system from crashing into artificial fight-or-flight loops.

actionSteps: Enforce a hard chemical cutoff for coffee or energy drinks strictly at 14:00.
Soldier.justification: Prevents artificial stimulation from masking deep exhaustion, allowing the body's natural adenosine levels to build up cleanly for sleep.

actionSteps: Enforce a 14:00 caffeine cutoff and swap afternoon coffee for a 5-minute deep box-breathing reset loop at your workstation.
Warrior.justification: Substitutes reliance on chemical adrenaline with conscious nervous system regulation to preserve focus endurance.

actionSteps: Execute your scheduled 45-minute continuous swimming block.
Focus on rhythmic, elongated under-water breath expansion pacing.
swimming.justification: Utilizes water resistance and deep hydrostatic pressure to flush built-up daytime mental cortisol while acting as Non-Sleep Deep Rest (NSDR).

actionSteps: Complete your chosen physical training loop.
Follow with 5 minutes of legs-up-the-wall positioning to drain pooled physical blood lactic metrics.
general_exercise.justification: Signals the motor cortex to initiate muscular and central nervous system repair pathways.

actionSteps: Open the app and complete step 1 and 2 only: Type out today's baseline situation and tap the primary emotion tag.
Survivor.justification: Lowers psychological friction to zero, building behavioral consistency without demanding complex semantic processing.

actionSteps: Complete a partial journaling entry: Log the Situation, Emotion, and explicitly select either the 'Cause & Effect' or 'Result & Excuse' NLP frame.
Soldier.justification: Begins breaking down unconscious justification mechanisms by forcing structural cognitive accountability.

actionSteps: Execute the complete 5-step NLP pipeline: Situation -> Emotion -> Selected NLP Frame -> Ease of Transition Slider -> End Feeling.
Log 3 clear blessings into the Bless Box to claim premium rewards points.
Warrior.justification: Rewrites subconscious reactive schemas by transitioning active stress points out of emotional centers into structural resolution loops.

actionSteps: Dim all household environmental lights and toggle app screens to warm lighting exactly 2 hours before your target sleep window.
Execute your non-negotiable meditation or breathwork block precisely at 22:30.
all.justification: Triggers rapid pineal gland melatonin synthesis while shifting the vagal tone completely into parasympathetic dominance for deep restorative sleep.
